focus: Regenerate/GET authorization gate (SPEC §9): JobPolicy#update? and #show? for admin / hiring-team member / outsider; verify regenerate is NOT credits-gated (mid-QA JobPolicy#update? change).
scenarios_run: Confirmed Pundit policy user is a User (Api::V1::BaseController `alias current_user current_api_v1_user`; no pundit_user override; ApplicationPolicy/JobPolicy call user.current_organization_user throughout).

Built ONE isolated org (uniquely-suffixed) with owner(org_owner), admin(org_admin), member(org_user + HiringTeamMembership on job), outsider(org_user, no membership); job has a description. Asserted on the User objects (correct policy-user).
JobPolicy.new(user, job).show?: admin=true, member=true, outsider=false (same effective results as update?).

Falsifiability: outsider update?/show? (false) diverge from member+admin (true); admin(35852) and outsider(35854) are absent from job.users while admin still passes via is_org_admin? and outsider fails, confirming the gate distinguishes hiring-team membership vs admin vs outsider rather than passing everyone.
